## Data

Spatial datasets used by the BEACONs Project for conservation planning in the boreal.

**Online datasets**

* [Medium resolution DEM (30m)](data/mrdem.qmd)
* [Landcover 2010, 2015, 2020 (30m)](data/landcover.qmd)
* [National hydro network (NHN)](data/nhn.qmd)

**Multiple datasets (needs updating)**

  - [Intactness]https://github.com/beaconsproject/conservation_resources/blob/master/data/intactness/intactness.md)
  - [Climate NA](https://github.com/beaconsproject/conservation_resources/blob/master/data/climateNA/cmi.md)

**Environmental surrogates** (older descriptions - to be updated)

  - `cmi` - [Climate moisture index](https://github.com/beaconsproject/conservation_resources/blob/master/data/cmi.md)
  - `gpp` - [Gross primary productivity](https://github.com/beaconsproject/conservation_resources/blob/master/data/gpp.md)
